name: @globiguard/open-workspace
description: Open distribution-layer monorepo for GlobiGuard packages.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @globiguard/contracts build && pnpm --filter @globiguard/sdk build && pnpm --filter @globiguard/react build && pnpm --filter n8n-nodes-globiguard build
scripts.build:publish: pnpm --filter @globiguard/contracts build && pnpm --filter @globiguard/sdk build && pnpm --filter @globiguard/react build
scripts.build:react-example-deps: pnpm --filter @globiguard/contracts build && pnpm --filter @globiguard/sdk build && pnpm --filter @globiguard/react build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @globiguard/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @globiguard/sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @globiguard/react typecheck && pnpm --filter n8n-nodes-globiguard typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @globiguard/contracts test && pnpm --filter @globiguard/sdk test && pnpm --filter @globiguard/react test && pnpm --filter n8n-nodes-globiguard test
